title: research: speed T16 audit mutation controls
body:
## Summary

Add a bounded source-pinned replay-runtime package for the selected PR1094 T16 asynchronous audit. The audit's 15 mutation controls previously deep-copied the full owner map for each small edit. The opt-in candidate shallow-copies only containers along the edited path and verifies that the original template remains unchanged.

Three alternating Linux / Python 3.12.3 process pairs on the same pinned fixture measured a 26.5959 s median for the original audit and 9.3909 s for the candidate: 2.832x faster, saving 17.2049 s (64.7%) in this stage.

## Verification

- All 15 original mutation controls are rejected in every original and candidate run.
- A one-byte change to the pinned audit source is rejected.
- The source-template snapshot remains unchanged through all candidate controls.
- All four generated outputs match the exact archived SHA-256 values.
- The bounded command and raw paired samples are in research/replay-runtime-audit-cow/verify.py and MEASUREMENTS.json.
- Package metadata and source pins pass scripts/research_package.py --package research/replay-runtime-audit-cow --check-only.

## Scope and credit

The verifier source is code/audit_allcold.py in the pinned PR1087 archive, head 589d1cedf5ef5f231182f4ec86408616311a8af0, SHA-256 1467a2acb654e62552c69fb9a7c4c85f70a02120881d222313865058ab71a6cc. Credit the PR858 / PR870 T16 controller lineage and Rohan Arun's selected PR1094 package and notices. Frozen source and replay artifacts remain unchanged.

This measures one verifier stage only. No full cold PR1094 replay, supplier admission, kappa change, selected-frontier update, or independent human review is claimed. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
